tagline: See every tag — and exactly which assets carry it.
lore: The Basset, nose held low, bred to read every scent mark on the trail — here it reads the marks the pack leaves: every tag and every asset under it.
problem: Tags are how the pack's work reaches Tenable, but once there are hundreds of categories and values, nobody can say what exists, how many assets carry each one, or whether a tag landed where it should.
does: Basset lists every tag in navi.db — one row per category : value with its asset count — searchable by category or value. Click a tag to see exactly which assets carry it, each linking to Argos and to the asset in Tenable.

glance.caption: Basset's results: each category : value with its asset count; clicking a tag lists the assets that carry it.

capabilities: one row per category : value, with its asset count and when it was first and last applied.
every asset carrying the tag — host, IP, OS, ACR, AES, when it was tagged, and a Tenable link.
how: Basset reads the tags and assets tables in your local navi.db and changes nothing. New tags appear after the next navi asset sync.
who: Anyone checking that a tag landed, auditing the tag estate, or finding the assets behind a tag.
better: Basset reads what the tagging hounds write. Garmr removes what no longer belongs, and the Tagging log shows each write from the pack's side.
cta: Check any tag with Basset — and see every asset that carries it.
